_meta.purpose: Specification of the 1,000-asset Korea test portfolio built by scripts/build_sample_portfolio.py from REAL OpenStreetMap buildings. Locations, footprints and use tags are OSM's; asset values are footprint x floors x the official 2026 building construction cost per m² (행정안전부 건물신축가격기준액) — a replacement-cost proxy, not a valuation. It exists to read the portfolio / asset-class / 시도 loss curves with a balanced class mix.

osm_extract.source: Geofabrik download server, https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/south-korea-261013.osm.pbf (OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-10-13)
osm_extract.licence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

selection_rule: Every OSM way/relation with a building tag listed below AND a usable building:levels tag (a positive number <= max_levels) — building=yes, untagged uses and buildings without a floor count are skipped: their use or size is unknown. Its class is fixed by the tag. Within each class buildings are visited in a seeded random order and accepted until the class count is reached, skipping any building whose hazard grid cell already holds max_per_cell_per_class buildings of that class; a building whose interior point falls outside every SGIS 시군구 polygon is not eligible.

asset_classes._note: Classes are the JRC sectors of physical_risk_config.json property_type_to_jrc_sector; each OSM tag maps to a property_type that maps to its class (checked by tests/test_sample_portfolio.py). n_assets per class sums to the top-level n_assets. Industrial is 190, not a third: floor-tagged industrial buildings fall in only 192 cells of the reference hazard grid, so one per cell cannot reach 333.

building_cost_source.name: 2026년 건물신축가격기준액 (행정안전부장관 고시; 지방세 건축물 시가표준액 산정의 ㎡당 신축 건축비)
building_cost_source.cited_from: 여수시, 「2026년 건축물 시가표준액 산정기준」, Ⅲ-1 건물신축가격기준액 및 붙임1 신구대비표 (2025년: 주거 840,000 · 상업 830,000 · 공업 820,000원/㎡)

fx.source: 한국은행 경제통계시스템(ECOS) 731Y004 「3.1.2.1. 주요국 통화의 대원화환율」, 원/미국달러(매매기준율), 2025년 평균자료

value_rule: asset_value_usd = footprint area (m², EPSG:5179) × floors × building_cost_krw_per_m2 ÷ krw_per_usd, rounded to the whole dollar. No lower or upper bound. floors = the OSM building:levels tag when it is a positive number ≤ max_levels, else the class default (never used under require_levels_tag). The cost is new-build cost per m² of floor area (재조달원가): the 시가표준액 structure / use / location indices and age depreciation (경과연수별 잔가율) are not applied.

hazard_cell_reference.name: river_flood_150arcsec_rcp85_KOR_2030_2050
hazard_cell_reference._note: Same 5,708-centroid 150-arcsec grid as tropical_cyclone_10synth_tracks_150arcsec_rcp85_KOR_2040 v2.1 (checked 2026-10-16), so one cell rule serves both perils.

cell_rule: A cell is the centroid of the hazard_cell_reference set a building is read from, matched with CLIMADA's match_coordinates exactly as Exposures.assign_centroids does it. The Korea Data API sets hold 5,708 of the 10,904 nodes of the 150-arcsec rectangle, so a coastal building can be read from a neighbouring node; rounding to the grid would miss that. Buildings in one cell share every hazard value, so more than one building of a class per cell adds no spatial information and concentrates the class's loss. The matched centroid is written to the CSV as hazard_centroid.
